info.title: Poly Haven downloads
info.description: The two hosts the api lane's documents point at: dl.polyhaven.org, a Backblaze B2 bucket (ph-assets) served by file name, where every file url of /files/{id} lives; and cdn.polyhaven.com, where an asset's thumbnail_url lives. Written from the api document's file and thumbnail_url fields and Backblaze's b2_download_file_by_name page (spec/SOURCE.md).

get.summary: Downloads one file using a bucket name and file name
get.description: To this base, you add file/, your bucket name, a /, and then the name of the file. The file name may itself include more / characters. The response contains the headers Content-Length, Content-Type, X-Bz-File-Name and X-Bz-Content-Sha1.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: The file name, which may itself include more / characters.

404.description: File with such name does not exist.

get.summary: The preview image thumbnail for an asset
get.description: The URL of the preview image thumbnail for this asset, as an asset's thumbnail_url names it (asset_img/thumbs/<id>.png, with width, height and v as query parameters).
